name: Temporary Field
description: A code smell where class fields are only used under certain circumstances and remain unused or empty the rest of the time. These fields often serve a purpose only within a specific algorithm or state.

refactoringTechniques.name: Extract Class
refactoringTechniques.description: Move the temporary fields and the code that uses them into a separate class that's used only when needed.

refactoringTechniques.name: Introduce Null Object
refactoringTechniques.description: Replace the check for a null field with a null object that provides the appropriate default behavior.

refactoringTechniques.name: Replace Method with Method Object
refactoringTechniques.description: Move the entire method and its local variables into a separate class, making the temporary fields instance variables of the new class.

refactoringTechniques.name: Extract Method
refactoringTechniques.description: Extract the code that uses the temporary fields into separate methods that receive the necessary data as parameters.
